title: The Path Inside the Lantern
goal: Follow the tiny path inside the lantern and light the glow meadow.
intro: Last time, a tiny path appeared inside the garden lantern. Tonight the lantern door is open just a crack. Your friends have clues and a tool to help you follow the path.
recap: You won a vine rope, read the map clue, crossed the tiny path, and lit the glow meadow together.
reveal: Surprise! The whole glow meadow lights up. Hundreds of tiny fireflies rise and make a shining crown in the air, just your size, Knight. Your friends planted the meadow for you.
hook: Tomorrow, one firefly flies away with a tiny note. Where is it going?

rooms.name: Lantern gate
lines: Look, Knight! The lantern door is open, and the tiny path is inside. Solve my number clue to win a rope for the trail.
You won the vine rope. The tiny path is waiting. Come back whenever you want.

rooms.name: Tiny moss path
lines: Everything is tiny in here! I found a clue card on this mossy path. Read it, then tie your rope across the gap.
You read the map and tied the rope. Now we can cross to the meadow!

rooms.name: Robo's acorn workshop
lines: Beep! Welcome to my workshop inside an acorn. I have extra treasures hidden here. You can visit whenever you want.
Your extra treasure can stay in your backpack. Beep boop!

rooms.name: Glow meadow
lines: You made it to the glow meadow, Knight. One last number clue will wake up the light.
Look at the meadow glowing all around you.

puzzles.title: Rope number clue
puzzles.prompt: Dad has 7 coils of vine rope. Each coil has 8 knots. How many knots are there?
puzzles.hint: Think of 7 groups of 8. You can start with 7 times 7 and add one more 7.
puzzles.goal: Win the vine rope for the tiny path.

puzzles.title: Read the clue card
puzzles.prompt: Build the word on Bo's clue card.
puzzles.hint: Tap each letter to hear its sound. Blend the sounds: m, a, p.
puzzles.goal: Read the clue card to find the way.

puzzles.title: Meadow light clue
puzzles.prompt: Mom has 63 fireflies. They share 9 flowers equally. How many fireflies go on each flower?
puzzles.hint: Which number times 9 makes 63? Count by nines.

puzzles.title: Acorn star clue
puzzles.prompt: Robo built 23 shelves. Each shelf holds 14 acorns. How many acorns are there?
puzzles.hint: Split it up: 23 times 10, then 23 times 4. Add them together.

puzzles.title: Find the digit value
puzzles.prompt: Robo's gear number is 5274. What is the value of the 7?
puzzles.hint: Say the places: thousands, hundreds, tens, ones. The 7 is in the tens place.

locks.label: Tie the vine rope
locks.hint: Win the vine rope at the lantern gate, then read the clue card on the moss path.
locks.goal: Tie your vine rope across the gap
